arm_B_against_its_own_throttled_version.reading: restoring the footprint moved arm B substantially in its own right -- AUC +19.8%, best +15.3%, final top-ten +15.3%. The throttle was real and removing it mattered.

budget.qualification_panel: NOT run -- the rule conditions it on QUALIFY and its budget was consumed by this re-run

caveats: one task, one seed, 250 charged calls per arm: this justifies or refuses the next scaling step, it is not a benchmark claim

control_reproduced_its_first_run_exactly.why_this_matters: arm A passes completion_law=None and the repaired adapter forwards getattr(..., None), so its code path is byte-identical. Reproducing its AUC and best score to the digit under concurrent load VALIDATES the matched design and shows the fix touched only the treatment.

named_limitation.effect_on_this_result: CONSERVATIVE. B finished ahead on top-ten mean and best score despite carrying less of the mechanism than a fully-threaded arm would.

score_by_completion_size_arm_B.note: charged endpoints, mean score, by the largest size the program's completion requested
score_by_completion_size_arm_B.reading: mid-range completions are the productive ones: 5-8 atoms mean 0.171 and 9-16 mean 0.153, both ABOVE the no-completion baseline of 0.134, while 1-4 sits below at 0.121. Small n per cell (4 and 6), so this is a direction to test, not a measured effect.

the_finding_is_the_CROSSOVER.mechanism: the completion mechanism COSTS EARLY AND PAYS LATE. B trails through the first half, overtakes at 200 calls, and finishes ahead on both the top-ten mean and the best score. AUC integrates the whole curve, so at a 250-call budget it charges B for the early deficit more than it credits the late gain.
the_finding_is_the_CROSSOVER.why_this_is_NOT_a_reason_to_change_the_m: AUC at the run's own budget is the predeclared primary metric and it is the right one for a fixed-budget comparison. The crossover is a finding ABOUT the mechanism, not a defect of the metric. What it licenses is a question -- does the crossover hold and widen at 1000 calls -- not a re-scoring of this run.
